gnosh mcp remove

  Remove a server.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp remove [flags] <name>

Flags
  -s, --scope <scope>
      Where the server is recorded: local (this project, on this machine; the
      default), user or project. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
